sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'France' AND s.outcome = 'Goal'
reponse: Requête qui compte les buts marqués par la France

sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) as nb_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY nb_buteurs DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'équipe avec le plus de buteurs différents

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_passes FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE pl.player_name = 'Luka Modric' AND (p.outcome IS NULL OR p.outcome NOT IN ('Incomplete', 'Out', 'Unknown', 'Pass Offside', 'Injury Clearance'))
interpretation: Une passe réussie est définie comme ayant outcome NULL ou un outcome absent de la liste des échecs
reponse: Requête qui compte les passes réussies de Luka Modric

sql: SELECT AVG(p.duration_seconds) as duree_moyenne FROM sb.possessions p
interpretation: Les tirs au but ne peuvent pas être explicitement exclus de la base (pas de marquage spécifique). Cette requête moyenne toutes les possessions sans distinction
reponse: Requête calculant la durée moyenne des possessions; les tirs au but ne sont probablement pas inclus dans la table possessions
L'âge des joueurs n'est pas disponible dans la base (pas de date de naissance en sb.players)
Le nombre de spectateurs n'est pas disponible dans la base (pas de colonne attendance en sb.matches)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_remplacements FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Substitution'
reponse: Requête qui compte tous les événements de substitution du tournoi

sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) as nb_corners FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE p.pass_type = 'Corner' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY nb_corners DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'équipe ayant tiré le plus de corners

sql: SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.reached_final_third THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) as proportion FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY proportion DESC
reponse: Requête qui calcule pour chaque équipe la proportion de possessions atteignant le dernier tiers adverse

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_fautes FROM sb.events WHERE type = 'Foul Committed' AND team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Uruguay')
reponse: Requête qui compte les fautes commises par l'Uruguay

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_own_goals FROM sb.events WHERE type IN ('Own Goal For', 'Own Goal Against')
interpretation: Compte les deux catégories de buts contre son camp disponibles dans la base
reponse: Requête retournant le nombre total de buts contre son camp

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.player_id) as nb_buteurs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal'
reponse: Requête qui compte le nombre de joueurs différents ayant marqué au moins un but

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.n_passes_reussies)::numeric / SUM(p.n_passes_tentees), 4) as taux FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Spain'
reponse: Requête qui calcule le taux de passes réussies de l'Espagne

sql: SELECT referee, COUNT(*) as nb_matchs FROM sb.matches WHERE referee IS NOT NULL GROUP BY referee ORDER BY nb_matchs DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'arbitre ayant dirigé le plus de matchs

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_centres FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'England' AND p.is_cross = true
reponse: Requête qui compte les centres tentés par l'Angleterre
L'information du club du joueur n'est pas disponible dans la base

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_cartons FROM sb.events WHERE (type = 'Bad Behaviour' AND (details #>> '{bad_behaviour,card,name}') = 'Yellow Card') OR (type = 'Foul Committed' AND (details #>> '{foul_committed,card,name}') = 'Yellow Card')
reponse: Requête qui compte tous les cartons jaunes distribués (Bad Behaviour et Foul Committed)

sql: SELECT DISTINCT stadium FROM sb.matches WHERE stage = 'Final'
reponse: Requête qui retourne le stade où s'est jouée la finale

sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) as nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE s.end_x < 83 GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY nb_tirs DESC
interpretation: Hors surface défini comme end_x < 83 (en supposant une normalisation 0-100 où la surface commence à x=83)
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'équipe ayant tenté le plus de tirs en dehors de la surface

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_nuls FROM sb.matches WHERE home_score = away_score
reponse: Requête qui compte les matchs terminés sur un score égal

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_matchs FROM sb.matches
reponse: Requête qui retourne le nombre total de matchs disputés
L'information sur les séances de tirs au but (gagnante/perdante) n'est pas explicitement disponible dans la base de données

sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as nb_passes_decisives FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON pa.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pa.goal_assist = true GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY nb_passes_decisives DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie le joueur ayant fourni le plus de passes décisives

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_passes_decisives FROM sb.passes pa JOIN sb.events e ON pa.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Eden Hazard' AND pa.goal_assist = true
reponse: Requête qui compte les passes décisives d'Eden Hazard

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'Croatia'
reponse: Requête qui compte tous les tirs tentés par la Croatie

sql: WITH earliest_goal AS (SELECT MIN(e.minute) as min_minute, MIN(e.second) as min_second FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal') SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id, earliest_goal eg WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.minute = eg.min_minute AND e.second = eg.min_second
reponse: Requête qui identifie le(s) joueur(s) ayant marqué le but le plus rapide du tournoi

sql: SELECT t.team_name, SUM(p.duration_seconds) as total_possession FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY total_possession DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'équipe ayant eu le plus de possession du ballon (durée totale)

sql: SELECT t.team_name, SUM(p.sum_xg) as total_xg FROM sb.possessions p JOIN sb.teams t ON p.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY total_xg DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie l'équipe ayant cumulé le plus d'expected goals

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.outcome IN ('Goal', 'Saved') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as pourcentage FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.team_name = 'France'
interpretation: Tir cadré défini comme outcome = 'Goal' ou 'Saved' (excluant 'Off T', 'Wayward', 'Blocked', 'Post')
reponse: Requête qui calcule le pourcentage des tirs de la France qui étaient cadrés

sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as nb_dribbles FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players p ON e.player_id = p.player_id WHERE e.type = 'Dribble' AND (e.details #>> '{dribble,outcome,name}') = 'Complete' GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY nb_dribbles DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie le joueur ayant réussi le plus de dribbles

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_tirs FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.stage = 'Final'
reponse: Requête qui compte tous les tirs tentés lors de la finale

sql: SELECT t1.team_name, t2.team_name, m.home_score + m.away_score as total_buts FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t1 ON m.home_team_id = t1.team_id JOIN sb.teams t2 ON m.away_team_id = t2.team_id ORDER BY total_buts DESC
reponse: Requête qui identifie le(s) match(es) ayant eu le plus de buts (somme des deux équipes)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_penalties FROM sb.shots s WHERE s.shot_type = 'Penalty' AND s.outcome = 'Goal'
reponse: Requête qui compte les penalties transformés en cours de match

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as nb_buts FROM sb.shots s JOIN sb.events e ON s.event_id = e.event_id WHERE s.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period = 2 AND e.minute >= 45
interpretation: Temps additionnel de la seconde période considéré comme les minutes >= 45 en période 2
reponse: Requête qui compte les buts marqués après la 45ème minute en seconde période

sql: SELECT pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as assists FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE pl.player_name = 'Hazard' AND p.goal_assist = true GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name
reponse: Compte les passes décisives (goal_assist = true) du joueur Hazard.

sql: WITH shot_counts AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as on_target_shots FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE sh.outcome IN ('Saved', 'Goal', 'Post') GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, on_target_shots FROM shot_counts WHERE on_target_shots = (SELECT MAX(on_target_shots) FROM shot_counts)
reponse: Retourne le(s) joueur(s) avec le plus de tirs cadrés (outcome IN ('Saved', 'Goal', 'Post')).

sql: WITH goals AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as goals FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE sh.outcome = 'Goal' GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, goals FROM goals WHERE goals = (SELECT MAX(goals) FROM goals)
reponse: Retourne le(s) meilleur(s) buteur(s) du tournoi avec nombre de buts.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as successful_through_balls FROM sb.passes WHERE is_through_ball = true AND outcome IS NULL
reponse: Compte les passes en profondeur réussies (is_through_ball = true ET outcome IS NULL).
La base ne contient pas de désignation du joueur du tournoi (distinction officielle). Il faudrait préciser le critère (meilleur buteur, passeur, xG cumulé, etc.).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as matches_played FROM sb.matches WHERE home_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Croatia') OR away_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Croatia')
reponse: Compte les matchs joués par la Croatie (équipe domicile ou équipe extérieure).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as direct_free_kick_goals FROM sb.passes WHERE pass_type = 'Free Kick' AND goal_assist = true
interpretation: Buts marqués par une passe de coup franc ayant directement assisté un but (pass_type = 'Free Kick' ET goal_assist = true). Cela exclut les buts marqués dans une action commençant par un coup franc mais ayant impliqué d'autres passes.
reponse: Compte les passes de coup franc ayant directement assisté un but.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as header_goals FROM sb.shots WHERE outcome = 'Goal' AND body_part = 'Head'
reponse: Compte les buts marqués de la tête (outcome = 'Goal' ET body_part = 'Head').

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_id) as teams_without_wins FROM sb.teams t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.matches m WHERE (m.home_team_id = t.team_id OR m.away_team_id = t.team_id) AND m.stage = 'Group Stage') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.matches m WHERE ((m.home_team_id = t.team_id AND m.home_score > m.away_score) OR (m.away_team_id = t.team_id AND m.away_score > m.home_score)) AND m.stage = 'Group Stage')
reponse: Compte les équipes qui ont joué en phase de groupes mais n'ont remporté aucun match.

sql: WITH goals_conceded AS ((SELECT home_team_id as team_id, SUM(away_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches GROUP BY home_team_id) UNION ALL (SELECT away_team_id as team_id, SUM(home_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches GROUP BY away_team_id)), team_totals AS (SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, SUM(gc.goals_conceded) as total_conceded FROM goals_conceded gc JOIN sb.teams t ON gc.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, total_conceded FROM team_totals WHERE total_conceded = (SELECT MAX(total_conceded) FROM team_totals)
reponse: Retourne l'équipe qui a encaissé le plus de buts au tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as shots FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE pl.player_name LIKE '%Mbappe%'
reponse: Compte les tirs tentés par Kylian Mbappe.

sql: SELECT pl.player_name, SUM(sh.statsbomb_xg) as total_xg FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name ORDER BY total_xg DESC LIMIT 5
reponse: Retourne les 5 joueurs avec le plus d'xG cumulé du tournoi.
La base contient les données de la Coupe du monde 2018, pas 2022. Aucune information sur l'édition 2022.

sql: WITH pass_stats AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as total_passes, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.outcome IS NULL THEN 1 END) as successful_passes FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_id, t.team_name), success_rates AS (SELECT team_name, successful_passes::float / total_passes as success_rate FROM pass_stats) SELECT team_name, success_rate FROM success_rates WHERE success_rate = (SELECT MAX(success_rate) FROM success_rates)
reponse: Retourne l'équipe avec le meilleur taux de passes réussies (outcome IS NULL).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as possessions_with_shots FROM sb.possessions WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Belgium') AND produced_shot = true
reponse: Compte les possessions de la Belgique qui ont produit un tir (produced_shot = true).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_goals FROM sb.shots WHERE outcome = 'Goal'
reponse: Compte le nombre total de buts marqués au tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN e.period = 1 THEN 1 END)::float / COUNT(*) as first_half_goal_ratio FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id WHERE sh.outcome = 'Goal'
reponse: Calcule la proportion des buts marqués en première période (period = 1).

sql: WITH distances AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.player_name, SUM(sqrt(power(c.end_x - e.loc_x, 2) + power(c.end_y - e.loc_y, 2))) as total_distance FROM sb.carries c JOIN sb.events e ON c.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE e.loc_x IS NOT NULL AND e.loc_y IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, total_distance FROM distances WHERE total_distance = (SELECT MAX(total_distance) FROM distances)
interpretation: Distance calculée à partir des carries (mouvements avec ballon), utilisant la distance euclidienne entre position initiale (event loc_x, loc_y) et position finale (carry end_x, end_y). Cela n'inclut que les carries, pas tous les déplacements.
reponse: Retourne le joueur ayant couvert la plus grande distance basée sur les carries.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as extra_time_goals FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id WHERE sh.outcome = 'Goal' AND e.period IN (3, 4)
interpretation: Buts marqués en période 3 et 4 (supposées être les prolongations, après la période régulière 1-2).
reponse: Compte les buts marqués durant les périodes 3-4 (supposées être les prolongations).

sql: WITH pass_counts AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.player_name, COUNT(*) as successful_passes FROM sb.passes p JOIN sb.events e ON p.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE p.outcome IS NULL GROUP BY pl.player_id, pl.player_name) SELECT player_name, successful_passes FROM pass_counts WHERE successful_passes = (SELECT MAX(successful_passes) FROM pass_counts)
reponse: Retourne le(s) joueur(s) avec le plus de passes réussies (outcome IS NULL).

sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) FROM sb.shots) as avg_shots_per_match FROM sb.shots
reponse: Calcule le nombre moyen de tirs par match au tournoi.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT pl.player_name FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed' AND e.details -> 'foul_committed' -> 'card' ->> 'name' = 'Red Card' ORDER BY pl.player_name
reponse: Retourne les joueurs ayant reçu un carton rouge (type = 'Foul Committed' avec card.name = 'Red Card').

sql: WITH goal_xg AS (SELECT pl.player_id, pl.player_name, sh.statsbomb_xg FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id JOIN sb.players pl ON e.player_id = pl.player_id WHERE sh.outcome = 'Goal') SELECT player_name, statsbomb_xg FROM goal_xg WHERE statsbomb_xg = (SELECT MIN(statsbomb_xg) FROM goal_xg)
reponse: Retourne le(s) joueur(s) ayant marqué le but avec le plus faible xG du tournoi.

sql: WITH foul_stats AS (SELECT e.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(*) as total_fouls, COUNT(DISTINCT e.match_id) as matches_played FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.teams t ON e.team_id = t.team_id WHERE e.type = 'Foul Committed' GROUP BY e.team_id, t.team_id, t.team_name), fouls_per_match AS (SELECT team_name, total_fouls::float / matches_played as fpm FROM foul_stats) SELECT team_name, fpm FROM fouls_per_match WHERE fpm = (SELECT MAX(fpm) FROM fouls_per_match)
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant commis le plus de fautes par match en moyenne.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as penalty_decided_matches FROM sb.matches m WHERE m.stage != 'Group Stage' AND m.home_score = m.away_score AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sb.shots sh JOIN sb.events e ON sh.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.match_id = m.match_id AND sh.shot_type = 'Penalty')
interpretation: Matchs hors phase de groupe avec score égal final, contenant des tirs de penalty (supposés être des séances de tirs au but).
reponse: Compte les matchs ayant probablement été décidés aux tirs au but (score égal final en non-groupe stage + existence de tirs penalty).
La base ne contient pas d'information sur la vitesse ou la puissance des tirs.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as match_penalties FROM sb.shots WHERE shot_type = 'Penalty' AND event_id IN (SELECT e.event_id FROM sb.events e WHERE e.period <= 4)
interpretation: Tirs de penalty en période 1-4 (en excluant supposément les tirs au but en période 5+). Les périodes représentant les tirs au but ne sont pas clairement définies dans le schéma.
reponse: Compte les tirs de penalty en période 1-4 (en supposant que les prolongations se terminent avant la période 5).

sql: SELECT t.team_name FROM sb.matches m JOIN sb.teams t ON ((m.home_score > m.away_score AND t.team_id = m.home_team_id) OR (m.away_score > m.home_score AND t.team_id = m.away_team_id)) WHERE m.stage = 'Final'
reponse: Retourne l'équipe gagnante de la finale du tournoi.

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as wins FROM sb.matches WHERE (home_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia') AND home_score > away_score) OR (away_team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'Russia') AND away_score > home_score)
reponse: Compte les matchs remportés par la Russie (comme équipe domicile ou extérieure).

sql: WITH goals_conceded AS ((SELECT home_team_id as team_id, SUM(away_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches GROUP BY home_team_id) UNION ALL (SELECT away_team_id as team_id, SUM(home_score) as goals_conceded FROM sb.matches GROUP BY away_team_id)), team_defense AS (SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, SUM(gc.goals_conceded) as total_conceded FROM goals_conceded gc JOIN sb.teams t ON gc.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name) SELECT team_name, total_conceded FROM team_defense WHERE total_conceded = (SELECT MIN(total_conceded) FROM team_defense)
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant encaissé le moins de buts (meilleure défense).

sql: WITH shots_against_count AS (SELECT CASE WHEN m.home_team_id = e.team_id THEN m.away_team_id ELSE m.home_team_id END as opponent_team_id, COUNT(*) as shots_against FROM sb.events e JOIN sb.matches m ON e.match_id = m.match_id WHERE e.type = 'Shot' GROUP BY opponent_team_id), ranked AS (SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, sa.shots_against FROM shots_against_count sa JOIN sb.teams t ON sa.opponent_team_id = t.team_id) SELECT team_name, shots_against FROM ranked WHERE shots_against = (SELECT MAX(shots_against) FROM ranked)
reponse: Retourne l'équipe ayant concédé le plus de tirs à ses adversaires.

sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as unique_starting_players FROM sb.lineups WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM sb.teams WHERE team_name = 'France')
reponse: Compte le nombre de joueurs différents alignés par la France dans les onze de départ au tournoi.
